articles.summary: Photoroom enhances its photo editing apps by optimizing inference latency, leveraging deep learning models compiled to TensorRT and the latest GPUs like the A10g, resulting in a remarkable server-side latency reduction by 3x with minimal cost. Using tools like Locust, they compare T4 and A10g configurations, finding A10g's lower latencies make it more cost-effective despite fewer instances needed.
articles.title: How we divided our server latency by 3 by switching from T4 GPUs to A10g
